title: Bribed Boolean function
statement: For a Boolean function $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\{-1,1\}$, a coordinate set $J\subseteq[n]$, and a sign $b\in\{-1,1\}$, define the modified function by evaluating $f$ on the input obtained by setting the coordinates in $J$ to $b$ and leaving all other coordinates unchanged.
